original.statement: A new CRD for Operation resources (ops.crossplane.io/v1alpha1) is added.

exposure.needed: whether the environment installs and manages Crossplane CRDs separately from the Helm release, rather than letting the chart install them

corrected.statement: A new CRD operations.ops.crossplane.io (Operation, ops.crossplane.io/v1alpha1) is added in the target release. Only environments that manage Crossplane CRDs separately from the release need to act: they must install the new CRD before upgrading.

decision.reason: The validator shows Operation v1alpha1 exists only in the target release [ev-9b2aa10ff338], so before the upgrade no environment's manifests can use it. That makes gvk-in-use the wrong test: it names an environment state that cannot exist yet, not the state in which anything happens. The only exposure the change text mentions is that environments managing CRDs separately from the release must install or update them. No static predicate captures that, so the condition should be undecidable.
